d: A slender build wearing a tattered, charcoal-grey suit with a long, ripped coat and brown leather boots. A white, shredded cloth veil covers the head and face, revealing a hollow interior filled with vibrant red poppies and white flowers. The outfit is adorned with a long white tattered shawl, a brown leather belt, and silver chains hanging with small blue rectangular charms. A small book with a red cover is held in hands wearing white gloves, while small black birds circle above the head.
